temperature.note: Interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.518 +/- 0.01 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
